verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a government tax and data service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence shows one. The only machine-readable surface is a read-only Socrata open-data endpoint on data.texas.gov, which is an adjacent building block rather than an MCP server. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and Webfile works only behind an authenticated eSystems session.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
